intro: Like a classic pearl—timeless, graceful, and functional—Pearl blends tradition with modern convenience. Thoughtfully designed with details and hidden storage, it turns any space into a serene retreat.

features.title: Traditional meets contemporary aesthetics
features.text: The perfect fusion of classic design and modern appeal, making this bed a timeless piece that suits any bedroom, bringing both elegance and practicality to your space.

features.title: Curved headboard and tailboard for soft elegance
features.text: The gently curved headboard and tailboard add a touch of softness, elevating the bed’s overall aesthetic while providing comfort and support.

features.title: Box storage for organised living
features.text: Maximise your room’s potential with inbuilt box storage, keeping linens, clothes, and essentials neatly stowed away but within easy reach, adding convenience to your space.

features.title: Seating space at the tailboard
features.text: The stylish tailboard doubles as extra seating, offering a cosy spot to sit, relax, or put on shoes, making this bed perfect for multi-functional rooms.

features.title: Metal understructure for durability
features.text: Built with a sturdy metal understructure, this bed ensures lasting strength and stability, giving you reliable support and peace of mind for years to come.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
